title: Pentagon Releases New Batch of UFO Files
description: The Pentagon released a new batch of UFO files on Friday, totaling 71 documents dated from 1952 to 2025.

title: Missing aircraft, orbs, and portals: Alaska UFO Town Hall lands in Juneau
description: For one afternoon in the capital city, the usual talk of state politics and cruise ship timetables took a detour into interdimensional portals, glowing orbs, and vanishing planes.

title: Department of defense drops sixth round of UAP files
description: The Department of Defense dropped the latest batch of declassified UAP files. NBC News' Gadi Schwartz speaks to Executive Director of the Disclosure Foundation Jordan Flowers about what is in the latest drop.

title: High-speed ‘floating orbs’ depicted in latest Pentagon UAP file release
description: The Department of War has released its sixth batch of declassified files on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP), uncovering reports and sensor data detailing silent, high-speed spherical objects moving across active military corridors.
